verdict.summary_en: Order acknowledgement OA25319404 from Boise Semiconductor Inc. to Soony Interactive GmbH for PO 4500318558 (dated 2025-10-02). One item: 9,500 pcs of CMP-GAM-002 Game Card 64 GB – Grand Heist 5 at 6.11 USD, confirmed for 2025-11-04. Terms are EXW Boise, NET30. The document is clean in appearance, with no handwriting or stamps.
red_flags: Terms wording is internally inconsistent: EXW Boise is stated and DDP is said not to be agreed, yet freight, insurance and duties are said to be prepaid by Seller and added to the invoice. Under EXW the buyer normally arranges these, so extra charges could appear on the invoice.
No total value is stated and no document date is shown (only the order date 2025-10-02 and confirmed delivery date 2025-11-04).
Unit of measure is not stated for the quantity 9,500.
observations: Single-page printed document with no handwriting, stamps, signatures or corrections.
The description wraps over three lines in the table (Game Card 64 / GB – Grand / Heist 5); all text is clear.
